function.name: uber_ride
function.description: Initiates an Uber carpool ride from a specified location and provides options for ride type, along with an estimated wait time for the customer. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loc.description: The starting location for the Uber ride in the format of 'Street Address, City, State'. For example, '1 Market St, San Francisco, CA'.

type.description: The type of Uber ride the user is requesting.

time.description: The maximum time the customer is willing to wait for the ride, in minutes.
